name: Aurora
tagline: A desk lamp in three temperatures.

parts.name: LED module
parts.material: 48 emitters on a milled heat sink

parts.name: Base
parts.material: weighted graphite, touch dial, linen cord

modes.label: Ember
modes.description: Ember is evening amber. It asks the day to sit down, keeps the desk warm and the ceiling out of the conversation.

modes.label: Focus
modes.description: Focus is neutral noon light. Crisp, shadowless and true to paper — the mode for hours that have to count.

modes.label: Studio
modes.description: Studio is north-window daylight for colour and detail — what a printmaker would choose at nine in the morning.

materials.name: Brushed aluminium
materials.spec: bead-blasted, sealed — ages to a soft matte
materials.caption: Brushed aluminium — shade shell, stem and knuckle joint

materials.name: Mouth-blown opal glass
materials.spec: 3.1 mm wall — no visible hot-spot at any mode
materials.caption: Opal glass diffuser — the only piece light touches

materials.name: Graphite composite
materials.spec: mineral-filled, 1.9 kg — planted, not bolted down
materials.caption: Graphite composite base — weighted, with the touch dial

materials.name: Braided linen cord

closing.headline: The end of the story — not the light.
closing.lead: Aurora stays where you put it, holds the angle you leave it at, and answers the dial without a single app. This page was the launch; the desk is up to you.

footerFiction: Aurora is a fictional product by an imaginary studio. No prices, no checkout, no stock — this microsite exists to tell one story in static files.
